I can do that, but I need a couple quick confirmations before I change the calendar and send invitations.

1) Which Friday do you mean? (This coming Friday / a specific date / every Friday?)
2) Which "Design Review" event should I move? (Event title, calendar, or a note about the current time/date so I can find it.)  
   - If there are multiple, tell me which one to move or I can list matching events for you to pick.
3) Timezone to use (your default calendar timezone or a specific one)?
4) Afternoon preference or constraints? I can pick a sensible slot in the afternoon (suggested defaults below) unless you prefer a window:
   - Option A (default): Friday 3:00–4:00 PM
   - Option B: Friday
